extra.message: course_blob_shelf_034 writes attacker-controlled content to disk using a caller-supplied filename. packet_ref comes directly from request.GET and drop_blob.name from request.FILES, then both are passed to FileSystemStorage.save() under BASE_EXPORT_DIR/'incoming'. This allows an attacker to create arbitrary files on the server (and is the classic path-traversal sink, CWE-22/CWE-434).

cwe: CWE-22: Path Traversal
CWE-434: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type

extra.message: course_roster_fold_036 has no _wrk_gate() check (unlike every sibling ops view) and no authentication/authorization, so it is reachable by any anonymous user. It returns internal operational data including 'renewal risk, payment flags, owner contact details'. This is broken access control / missing authentication.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
CWE-862: Missing Authorization

extra.message: course_return_lane_151 reads the redirect target from request.GET/request.POST ('lane') and passes it straight to django.shortcuts.redirect(). An attacker can supply an absolute URL such as https://evil.example to redirect victims off-site (open redirect), enabling phishing/OAuth token theft.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: course_bundle_thaw_175 calls pickle.loads() on raw attacker-controlled data taken from request.body (optionally base64-decoded from the 'blob' GET parameter). Pickle deserialization of untrusted input allows arbitrary code execution on the server (RCE).

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: course_workset_rebind_198 builds a workset with security attributes (role, tier, approved, balance) and then blindly merges the full attacker-controlled JSON body via workset.update(payload). Any client can override role/tier/approved/balance (mass assignment / parameter tampering).

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes
CWE-602: Client-Side Enforcement of Server-Side Security

extra.message: course_wire_tally_220 logs the full request body and the Authorization bearer header at WARNING level. Credentials/tokens and request payloads are written to application logs where they can be read by operators or leaked via log aggregation (sensitive information in logs).

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: course_digest_fold_278 derives a digest from a user-supplied phrase using hashlib.md5(). MD5 is cryptographically broken (collision-prone) and must not be used for security-sensitive digests/tokens; use SHA-256 or stronger (or a password KDF if the value is a secret).

cwe: CWE-327: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm

extra.message: course_identity_hint_457 authenticates using hardcoded verifier codes ('north' -> '4812', 'south' -> '5930') embedded in source, and compares them with the non-constant-time '!=' operator. Hardcoded secrets are exposed to anyone with source/artifact access and cannot be rotated (also a timing side channel).

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hardcoded Credentials
CWE-208: Observable Timing Discrepancy

extra.message: course_origin_mirror_467 reflects the attacker-controlled Origin request header into Access-Control-Allow-Origin and sets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. Any website can therefore make credentialed cross-origin requests and read authenticated responses, defeating the same-origin policy.

cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains

extra.message: course_frame_slip_477 explicitly disables browser protections by setting X-XSS-Protection: 0 and an empty Content-Security-Policy header, weakening defense-in-depth against cross-site scripting for responses served by this endpoint.

cwe: CWE-16: Configuration
CWE-693: Protection Mechanism Failure

extra.message: course_jinja_cast_489 concatenates the user-controlled 'fragment' GET parameter into a Jinja2 Template string and renders it. This is server-side template injection: an attacker can inject template expressions (e.g. {{ config }}, {{ ''.__class__.__mro__ }}) leading to information disclosure and remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

extra.message: course_shell_probe_501 builds a shell command by concatenating the user-controlled 'host' GET parameter into os.system('ping -c 1 ' + host). Shell metacharacters (e.g. ;, &&, |, $()) allow arbitrary OS command execution on the server.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

extra.message: course_nonce_roll_509 generates a security nonce/code with random.choice() from the non-cryptographic PRNG (and a user-controlled length). Mersenne Twister output is predictable, so generated nonces/tokens can be guessed; use the secrets module instead.

cwe: CWE-338: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG)

extra.message: course_xml_fold_519 parses attacker-controlled request.body with lxml etree.XMLParser(load_dtd=True, resolve_entities=True, no_network=False). External entity resolution is enabled, allowing XXE: file disclosure, SSRF, and denial of service via entity expansion.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: course_badge_gate_527 grants elevated privileges ('elevated' lane, full payroll/casework access) purely when a client-controlled cookie or header value equals the hardcoded string 'lead'. Any user can set Cookie: ops_badge=lead or X-Ops-Badge: lead to bypass authorization (broken authentication).

cwe: CWE-287: Improper Authentication
CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: course_trace_panel_537 returns internal implementation details to the caller: the DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE value and the absolute private export directory path (BASE_EXPORT_DIR). This information disclosure aids further attacks and leaks server filesystem layout.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

extra.message: course_trust_drift_547 calls ssl._create_unverified_context() and uses it for urllib.request.urlopen(), disabling TLS certificate verification. This makes the outbound HTTPS connection vulnerable to man-in-the-middle interception/spoofing.

cwe: CWE-295: Improper Certificate Validation
